purpose: Define one canonical site-wide style and explicit web asset registry as presentation semantics under Expose, separate from domain/runtime authority.

does_not_own: runtime execution authority unless explicitly referenced

topics.name: Style and Assets
topics.purpose: Define one canonical site-wide style and explicit web asset registry as presentation semantics under Expose, separate from domain/runtime authority.

semantics.style_rule: One canonical site-wide style definition may be overridden only through explicit style semantics/configuration.
semantics.asset_rule: Images/assets have explicit identities and references.
semantics.presentation_rule: Style affects presentation only and cannot create semantic structure, authority or execution behavior.
semantics.editor_rule: Style Editor edits canonical style/assets through authorized operations.
semantics.projection_rule: Rendered CSS/layout is derived from canonical style; renderer-specific output is not semantic authority.
semantics.localization_rule: Style is separate from UI label/localization semantics.

invariants.rule: Expose, nanoCMS, MetaModules and Editor remain projections/compositions over canonical semantics and never create hidden runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: asset identity inferred only from filename/path where explicit identity is required
renderer output treated as source of truth

prose.summary: Define one canonical site-wide style and explicit web asset registry as presentation semantics under Expose, separate from domain/runtime authority.
notes: Unlocked until reconciled against existing Expose/nanoCMS/Meta contracts and repository-wide Contract Format 1.4 validation.
